(no arguments): hand-written assembly (filled branch delay slots, a mova jump table, bounded five-read waits), the external-interrupt service for requests from the DIMM board: counts the call in 0x0c01ff14; when the board word dimm_board_id_word lacks bit 29 and a G1 DMA runs (0xa05f7418) it only masks the board interrupt (clears bit 3 of 0xa05f6914), sets 0x0c01ff08 and returns; otherwise reads the command register 0xa05f703c and, for a request (bit 15, or always when bit 29 is set), dispatches on bits 9-14: 0 answers with the low byte of the comms word dimm_comms_mode, 1 also returns the word 0x0c01ff04 in the parameter registers (-1 when the top bits are not 0), 3 stores the base address from the parameter registers in the word dimm_shared_area, 4/5/6 read a byte/halfword/word at base + (top bits << 16 | offset register 0xa05f7040) into the parameter registers 0xa05f7044/7048, 8/9/10 write one (a misaligned halfword or word answers 0), the others answer -1; command 16 and up is handed to the function in dimm_cmd_hook_vector (0x0c018068) when one is set, and that path (0x0C125F40-0x0C125F9C) writes none of the four registers and leaves status bit 0 alone; on the jump-table path it then waits for bit 0 of the status register 0xa05f704c, writes the answer, offset and parameters back (the offset and both parameter registers are always written, from r9, r10, r11: commands 3, 8, 9, 10, the -1 answers and the misaligned ones leave those holding the command number, the command word's bits 0-8 and the whole command word), counts the reply in 0x0c01ff10, sets status bit 8, reads the external status 0xa05f6904 at most five times for bit 3 to drop and clears status bit 0 (and bit 8 when bit 29 is set); a non-request just sets bit 8 and waits for bit 3 to drop (register meanings: libnaomi dimmcomms.c and holly.h, public); returns 0; its only reference is dimm_request_hook_install, which stores its address in dimm_request_hook_vector (the BIOS vector word 0x0C018064) and does not call it; it is entered from the BIOS interrupt dispatch outside the image (return address 0x0c001d50); part of NLADIMM; corrected from the live log 2026-11-10: all four logged calls came from outside the image (return address 0x0c001d50, stack at 0xac0007ec), about once a second in the attract demo;
